v9_architecture_specification.backward_compatibility: Exports identical public entrypoints (`render_tactical_map_frame`, `bake_tactical_map_mp4`, `get_tactical_map_preset`, `list_tactical_map_presets`, `compute_map_camera_zoom_state`) plus `validate_v9_minimalist_map_spec(spec)` for `historical_visual_qc.py`.

minimalism_budget_hard_caps.recommended_words_per_label: 1 to 2 words (e.g. 'LIỄU THĂNG', 'TRẦN LỰU', 'BẪY MÃ YÊN', 'SẬP CỌC LIM')

typography_scale_contract.no_shrink_below_floor_rule: Never auto-shrink font below 5.0% of canvas height (`>= 128px` on `1440x2560`, `>= 54px` on `1920x1080`). Specs with >3 words or >16 chars fail validation instead of shrinking font!
typography_scale_contract.rendering_treatment: 100% Zero-Box Cinema Typography: crisp thick dark woodblock/obsidian outline (`stroke_width = round(0.068 * font_px)`) + soft Gaussian optical drop-scrim (`alpha=160, blur_radius=0.35*font_px`), ZERO rectangular boxes, ZERO pills, ZERO side stripes.

acts.camera_behavior: Calm overhead terrain lock (`zoom: 1.00 -> 1.03`, subtle ease-out settle) with peripheral spotlight vignette (`18%`) framing the river/gorge bottleneck.
acts.visual_elements_active: Sculpted DEM hillshade + flowing river bathymetry + fortress/pass marker ONLY. Zero moving units, zero arrows.
acts.labels_active: Max 2 labels: Tier-1 Theater Stamp at top-center (e.g. 'CHI LĂNG 1427', fade-in 0.22s, full 100% hold 0.22s..2.25s, clean fade-out 2.25s..2.55s) + optional 1 Tier-2 Focal Terrain Pin ('ẢI HIỂM ĐỊA').
acts.cognitive_purpose: Viewer's eye locks onto geography (mountain walls, river bend, choke point) before any troop motion begins — replicating Operations Room & Kings and Generals.

acts.camera_behavior: Ultra-smooth ease-in-out drift (`zoom: 1.03 -> 1.08`) tracking between opposing vanguard positions.
acts.visual_elements_active: 1 to 2 giant rotated faction blocks (`136x84px` on 9:16, `110x68px` on 16:9) materialize with crisp 0.25s scale-settle (`1.12x -> 1.00x`) and advance deliberately along initial approach waypoints (`t_norm = 0.30..0.60`); submerged stakes begin emerging if tidal.
acts.labels_active: Phase 1 headline is 100% GONE. ONLY 1-2 Tier-2 Giant Commander/Force Labels ('LIỄU THĂNG' + 'TRẦN LỰU', 1-2 words each) ride upright above/beside their blocks at 100% opacity (`2.70s..5.30s`), then cross-fade out cleanly at `5.30s..5.60s` so arrows never collide with text!
acts.cognitive_purpose: Viewer effortlessly reads WHO is fighting and WHERE each force stands without competing arrows or titles.

acts.camera_behavior: Deliberate push into ambush kill-zone (`zoom: 1.08 -> 1.16` normal, or optional final-0.55s `map_camera_zoom_match` `1.16 -> 2.35` on Long boundary cuts).
acts.visual_elements_active: Slow sculpted Bezier/Catmull-Rom maneuver arrows (`shaft=38px` on 9:16 / `31px` on 16:9) glide across `2.8s-3.6s` (`t_norm = 0.61..0.90`), converging on enemy block; concentric crimson/gold shockwave rings (`2` calm smooth waves, zero high-freq jitter) trigger at `t_norm = 0.78` (`~7.0s`) and hold cleanly to `9.0s`.
acts.labels_active: Unit name labels are cleared; SINGLE Tier-1 Giant Impact Stamp ('BẪY MÃ YÊN' / 'SẬP CỌC LIM', 2-3 words) locks at top-center at 100% contrast from `5.75s` to `8.75s` (`>= 3.0s` full-opacity hold).
acts.cognitive_purpose: Viewer watches the feigned retreat, flanking pincer, and trap closure unfold at human comprehension speed, reinforced by 1 giant verdict phrase.

slow_3_act_choreography_timeline.short_visual_pacing_integration_rule: In `sys/visual_pacing.py`, `short_9x16_flow_video` enforces `body_max = 6.80s` per individual beat. Therefore, V9 supports two sanctioned Short integration patterns: (A) Single-beat Short map (`duration_sec = 6.4s..6.75s`: Act 1 `0-1.8s`, Act 2 `1.8-4.1s`, Act 3 `4.1-6.6s`), OR (B) Preferred Two-Beat Continuous Map (`duration_sec = 8.4s..10.0s` baked once at 30fps and split losslessly at narration beat boundary `t_split` across two adjacent `scene_map` beats joined with `hard_cut` 0.0s overlap — giving 9.0s uninterrupted slow map viewing while keeping per-beat hold `4.2s..5.0s <= 6.80s`).
